messages:
alex_cs: quick heads-up — did a perf pass for Horizon during onboarding. Noticed a persistent 30% tail latency spike around 512-token requests on their main route. Putting a few low-risk suggestions here for ops/dev sync.

maria_se: can you paste the metric slices + sample traces?

alex_cs: sure — top-level: p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 980ms for seq len 512 on redwood-4xl; error rate stable. Saw KV cache hit rate ~ 68%. Most long tails coincide with cold KV misses and bursty bursts from their nightly batch jobs.

# sample traces (sanitized):
```
request_id=hz-2024-07-07-11, model=redwood-4xl, tokens=512, kv_hit=false, latency_ms=1024
request_id=hz-2024-07-07-14, model=redwood-4xl, tokens=512, kv_hit=true, latency_ms=310
```

devon_solutions: :eyes: couple low-risk levers we can try in order: 1) enable prefix KV caching for their hot templates, 2) try int8 quantized variant of 4xl for a canary (small perf cost to quality), 3) route long-sequence requests to a high-memory pool w/ warmed KV.

maria_se: what's the expected unit-savings / latency impact for int8 swap? and do we have a quick eval?

alex_cs: rough numbers from internal bench: int8-4xl -> ~22% lower p50/p95, p99 improvement varies; quality delta small on our canonical prompt set but we should run Horizon's prompts. Suggest canary: 2% traffic to quantized variant + A/B quality hooks.

devon_solutions: config snippet for canary rollout (example):
```
redwood rollout create --customer horizon --route /summarize --from redwood-4xl --to redwood-4xl-int8 --percent 2 --watch
```

ops_bot: scheduled canary window requested by @devon_solutions for 2024-07-10T02:00Z to 2024-07-10T06:00Z. Will auto-rollback on quality regression > 1.5% or error spike.

tara_horizon: thanks — we care a lot about consistency. Can we run a short QA on our dev dataset before the canary? Also want to avoid any hallucination regressions.

alex_cs: absolutely — proposed plan: 1) run short eval on Tara's dataset (we'll need sample prompts + thresholds), 2) enable prefix caching for top 5 templates (no code changes), 3) run 48h canary at 2% for int8, 4) collect fail/error/quality metrics and then expand to 10% if green.

maria_se: assigning owners: @tara_horizon to provide 200 sample prompts & quality thresholds by EOD, @devon_solutions to create rollout and prepare monitoring, @alex_cs to enable prefix cache and validate traces.

tara_horizon: I'll upload samples by EOD and add a quick rubric. Appreciate the low-risk approach. :thumbsup:

alex_cs: noted, I'll post the preflight checklist and the monitoring dashboard link once setup.

devon_solutions: one more note — if the canary shows edge-case regressions on reasoning prompts, fallback policy will route those requests to the existing non-quantized variant (route-level policy).

maria_se: perfect. tagging renewal lead — small wins on latency help the renewal conversation. :smile:

ops_bot: action created: CS-1278 (Horizon quant canary) assigned to devon_solutions, due 2024-07-12.

alex_cs: thanks team — next update after QA run or once canary is live.
